name: lhlogging-dashboard
description: Faceplate conformance tooling. The app itself is Python; this only provides `npm run check`. There are no dependencies to install -- bin/faceplate.mjs is vendored from faceplate v3.0.0 (sha256 0ab8ee6085e4aa5a71983f278abbca8d13af79c1922a5c4e607e7392e44e867d), together with dist/, fonts.css and fonts/, because the upstream repo is private and CI has no credentials for it. It reads its values from the checksummed dist/tokens.json.
